name: Beijing Jiuzhouyigui Environmental Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Jiuzhouyigui Environmental Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the design, research and development, manufacturing, and sale of vibration and noise reduction technologies for rail transit in China.
